components.title: Type of container and closure used for the dosage form and reconstitution diluent, if applicable
Container and closure — dosage form
components.prompt: ESSENCE: Type of container and closure used for the finished dosage form (blister, bottle, cap type, desiccant, etc.). CONTRACT: Packaging narrative focused on container/closure system; include primary and secondary pack when described in source. Do not include unit formula or reconstitution diluent chemistry unless describing the diluent's container. SOURCE: technical_intelligence.p1 packing/packaging, common_info, and p7 when cross-referenced for container description.

components.title: Container and closure — reconstitution diluent
components.prompt: ESSENCE: Container and closure for any accompanying reconstitution diluent. CONTRACT: If no diluent is supplied, state 'Not applicable.' Do not duplicate dosage-form container text. SOURCE: p1/p7 diluent packaging when present.
